components.name: Primary Button
components.css: .ds-button { background: #0F766E; color: #FFFFFF; font: inherit; font-weight: 600; padding: 8px 24px; border: 0; border-radius: 4px; cursor: pointer; transition: 200ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1) 0ms; } .ds-button:hover { background: #CCFBEF; color: #042F2E; } .ds-button:active { transform: translateY(1px); } .ds-button:focus-visible { outline: 1px solid #0F766E; outline-offset: 4px; }

components.name: Input
components.description: A quiet text field with an explicit label.
components.css: .ds-field { display: grid; gap: 4px; color: #1C1917; } .ds-field input { padding: 8px 16px; background: #FAFAF9; color: inherit; border: 1px solid currentColor; border-radius: 4px; transition: border-color 200ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1) 0ms; } .ds-field input:hover { border-color: #0F766E; } .ds-field input:focus-visible { outline: 1px solid #0F766E; outline-offset: 4px; }

components.name: Navigation
components.description: A compact landmark with one active destination.
components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; gap: 24px; padding: 16px 24px; background: #FAFAF9; } .ds-nav a { color: #1C1917; transition: color 200ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1) 0ms; } .ds-nav a:hover, .ds-nav [aria-current] { color: #0F766E; } .ds-nav a:focus-visible { outline: 1px solid #0F766E; outline-offset: 4px; }

components.name: Chip
components.description: Short categorical metadata, never a primary action.
components.css: .ds-chip { display: inline-flex; padding: 4px 8px; color: #042F2E; background: #CCFBEF; border-radius: 999px; font-weight: 600; }

components.name: Card
components.description: A grouped unit with restrained depth.
components.css: .ds-card { padding: 24px; color: #1C1917; background: #FAFAF9; border-radius: 8px; box-shadow: 0px 4px 24px 0px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.12); }

components.name: Eyebrow
components.description: Editorial pre-heading for context, not decoration.
components.css: .ds-eyebrow { margin: 0 0 8px; color: #0F766E; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 1px; text-transform: uppercase; }

components.name: Rule
components.description: A single structural thread between editorial blocks.

components.name: Frame
components.description: The bounded editorial canvas used by documents and decks.
components.css: .ds-frame { max-width: 72rem; margin-inline: auto; padding: 48px 24px; color: #1C1917; background: #FAFAF9; }

narrative.northStar: Creative North Star: "Quiet evidence, unmistakable action."** The system keeps information calm
narrative.overview:
**Creative North Star: "Quiet evidence, unmistakable action."** The system keeps information calm
and legible, then spends one accent on the decision that matters. It should feel deliberate rather
than decorated.

- **Restrained:** hierarchy comes from scale and space before ornament.
- **Evidence-led:** supporting material sits beside the claim it proves.
- **Decisive:** one accent thread identifies action and structure.
keyCharacteristics: Restrained:: hierarchy comes from scale and space before ornament.
Evidence-led:: supporting material sits beside the claim it proves.
Decisive:: one accent thread identifies action and structure.

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: One block gets one accent role; a second accent must encode meaning rather

dos: **Do** keep every primitive declaration in `/.design/tokens.json` and regenerate adapters.
**Do** preserve accessible foreground/background pairs and semantic heading order.
**Do** inspect the actual HTML, deck, or PDF after rendering.
donts: **Don't** copy a color, type size, radius, or spacing value into a medium primitive.
**Don't** use an asset whose license and binding role are not recorded.
**Don't** treat the lossy DESIGN.md projection as the whole DTCG source.
